hooks.name: Log each spec task
hooks.description: After a spec task runs, reminds the agent to record it honestly in BUILD_LOG.md.

action.prompt: Append one dated line to BUILD_LOG.md for the task that just ran: task number, what changed, and the real result of `cargo test --workspace` (paste the 'test result' lines). If tests were not run or failed, say so. Never record a check you did not perform.
